title: Describing Characters
subtitle: Use adjectives and 'is / isn't' to describe game characters
description: Learn 12 adjectives to describe game characters and use is / isn't to talk about them.

vocabulary.definition: Large in size — takes up a lot of space.
vocabulary.example: The boss is BIG — he fills the whole screen!
The fairy is SMALL — she can hide behind a rock.
My character is FAST — nobody can catch her!

vocabulary.definition: Does not move quickly — takes a long time.
vocabulary.example: The stone giant is SLOW but very strong.

vocabulary.definition: Has a lot of physical power.
vocabulary.example: The warrior is STRONG — one punch destroys the wall!

vocabulary.definition: Does not have much power — easy to defeat.
vocabulary.example: At level 1, my character is WEAK and has low HP.
The final boss is SCARY — I don't want to fight him!
The village merchant is FRIENDLY and gives you quests.

vocabulary.definition: Has special powers or uses magic.
vocabulary.example: The wizard is MAGICAL — she can fly and throw spells.
The knight is ARMOURED — arrows can't hurt him easily.

vocabulary.definition: High from top to bottom — the opposite of short.
vocabulary.example: The dragon is TALL — taller than any building in the game.

vocabulary.definition: Can cause a lot of damage or harm.
vocabulary.example: Don't go near that enemy — it is very DANGEROUS!

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use this to describe a character with one adjective.
phrasalVerbs.example: This character is fast and very dangerous.

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use isn't to say what a character is NOT like.
phrasalVerbs.example: She isn't slow — she is the fastest in the game!

phrasalVerbs.definition: Add very before an adjective to make it stronger.
phrasalVerbs.example: My character is very strong — he can beat any enemy.

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use this to ask someone about their character.
phrasalVerbs.example: Is your character magical? Mine is armoured.

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use and to join two adjectives together.
phrasalVerbs.example: The boss is big and scary — I need help!

phrasalVerbs.definition: Use I think to give your personal opinion.
phrasalVerbs.example: I think she is the most dangerous character in the game.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: Have you seen the new boss in World 4? Is it [[scary:Frightening — makes you feel afraid]]?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Scary? It is terrifying! The boss is [[big:Large in size]] and very [[dangerous:Can cause a lot of damage or harm]].

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: Oh no! Is it [[fast:Moves very quickly]] too? My character isn't very fast.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: No — the boss is actually [[slow:Does not move quickly]]. But it is extremely [[strong:Has a lot of physical power]].

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: OK so my character is [[small:Not big — little in size]] and [[fast:Moves very quickly]]. Can I dodge its attacks?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Yes! Your character is perfect for this boss. She is very [[magical:Has special powers or uses magic]] too, right?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: She is! She has a fire spell. But the boss — is it [[armoured:Wearing protective metal or equipment]]?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: It is [[armoured:Wearing protective metal or equipment]] on the front. But it isn't armoured on its back!

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: Perfect! I'll attack from behind. My character is [[strong:Has a lot of physical power]] enough from behind.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Exactly! The boss is [[scary:Frightening — makes you feel afraid]] but it isn't impossible. You can beat it!

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.text: OK — I think the boss is [[dangerous:Can cause a lot of damage or harm]] but my character is [[magical:Has special powers or uses magic]] and [[fast:Moves very quickly]]. I'm ready!

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: That's the spirit! I think your character is the best for this fight. Good luck!
